definitionZh: 位置- try-order CSS 属性允许您指定各种后退选项,这些选项会导致可用的位置-try后退用于设定锚位元素的位置,而不是其初始位置设置.
sourceDefinition: The position-try-order CSS property allows you to specify various fallback options that result in an available position-try fallback being used to set an anchor-positioned element's position, instead of its initial position settings.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The position-try-order CSS property allows you to specify various fallback options that result in an available position-try fallback being used to set an anchor-positioned element's position, instead of its initial position settings.
